fullDescription: A pure-black CRT terminal-themed SaaS pricing page in phosphor green and monospace, with a 3-tier card row (Pro highlighted), an animated monthly/annual toggle, and a man-page-style comparison matrix in a fake terminal window.

structured.summary: A terminal/CRT-themed SaaS dev-tool pricing page for a prompt-library product, rendered as a near-black console UI with phosphor-green text, scanline overlay, monospaced type, and a shell-command motif (install lines, $ prompts, ./start CTAs). Layout is a single centered max-w-[1180px] column: announcement bar, sticky blurred nav, a plain-text hero, a monthly/annual billing toggle, a 3-tier card row (Free/Pro/Team, Pro highlighted), a man-page-style comparison matrix in a fake terminal window, an accordion FAQ, and a grid-lined footer.

style.description: Electric-dark terminal aesthetic: pure-black canvas washed with faint green radial glows, a fixed CRT scanline overlay, and bright phosphor-green (#39ff7a) as the single accent doing all the work via text-shadow glows. Everything is monospaced; surfaces are barely-there off-black panels hairlined in dim green. Amber and cyan exist only as tiny accents (discount badge, traffic-light dots). The vibe is a console/REPL, not a glossy marketing page.
style.prompt: Build a dark terminal/CRT-themed UI. Palette (exact): background pure black #000000 with two soft radial-gradient green glows (rgba(57,255,122,0.08) top-right, rgba(57,255,122,0.05) left); panel surfaces #050805 (panel) and #070b07 (panel2); hairline borders #143614 (line) and #1f4d1f (line2, brighter); primary phosphor green #39ff7a (phos), dimmer green #2bbf5c (phosdim), faint green #1c7a3c (phosfaint); muted sage text #5f8d68 (ash); accent amber #ffd24a (used only for the -17% discount badge); accent cyan #5cf6ff (unused decorative). Text defaults to phosdim green on black. Typography: monospace everywhere via Google Fonts 'JetBrains Mono' (weights 400-800, primary) and 'IBM Plex Mono' (weights 400-600, secondary); tight tracking on headings (tracking-tight), wide letter-spacing on small uppercase labels (tracking-[0.16em]-[0.2em]). Signature effects: a fixed full-screen CRT scanline overlay (repeating-linear-gradient of faint dark horizontal lines, mix-blend-mode:multiply, opacity 0.5, z-60); a 'glow' green text-shadow (0 0 8px rgba(57,255,122,0.45), 0 0 24px rgba(57,255,122,0.18)) on key headings and a softer 'glow-soft' variant; green box-shadow halo (hl-glow) on the highlighted card; inset 1px green cardline on panels; a blinking block cursor ▋ and a blinking square dot (1.1s step-end); green text selection (::selection bg rgba(57,255,122,0.30)). Custom list bullets render as ASCII: checked = [✓] in green (.tick::before content '[\002713]'), unchecked = [ ] in faint green (.nope). Rounded corners are small (rounded-[3px] to rounded-lg). html scroll-behavior smooth; focus-visible outlines are 2px solid #39ff7a.

layout_and_structure.description: Single frameless responsive web page, vertically stacked, all content in one centered column at max-width 1180px (mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-5 sm:px-6). Reads top-to-bottom: announcement bar, sticky nav, hero, billing-toggle header, 3 pricing cards, comparison terminal, FAQ, footer. The pricing cards reflow 3 -> 2 -> 1 column across lg/md/mobile breakpoints; the comparison swaps from a full matrix table on >=sm to per-tier stacked cards on mobile. Nav is sticky with a blurred translucent black background.

prompts.prompt: A full-width solid phosphor-green (#39ff7a) bar with black text, centered max-w-[1180px] content, ~py-2. Left: a blinking small black square dot + version tag 'v4.2' (hidden on mobile). Center: a truncating line 'new: 12,400+ vetted prompts shipped to the open library this week.' with the count bolded. Right (ml-auto): a small black pill button 'changelog ->' (black bg, green text, arrow icon).

sticky top-0 z-50 header with backdrop-blur-md, semi-transparent black bg (bg-black/80), bottom border in dim green (border-line). 60px tall row, centered max-w-[1180px]. Left: logo = a small 8x8 rounded square with a 1px green border + glowing 'terminal' icon, followed by wordmark 'promptd' in extrabold green (glow-soft) with '.dev' in faint green. Center (hidden on mobile, md:flex): lowercase text nav links 'library / skill / docs / pricing' in ash green, hover turns phos green with a faint green bg; the active 'pricing' link is already green on bg-phos/5. Right (ml-auto): a '~/login' text link (hidden on mobile) and a solid green './start' button (black text, rounded-[4px], glow-soft).

Left-aligned plain-text hero, pt-14 sm:pt-20 pb-10, with a faint horizontal gradient hairline above it. Eyebrow in monospace caps with wide tracking: '$ man promptd-pricing' (the '$' in ash). Big extrabold green H1 with strong glow, responsive 4xl -> 58px: 'Pricing, in plain text.' Sub-paragraph in ash green, max-w-2xl, explaining the one-library / pipe-into-agent value, ending with a blinking green block cursor ▋. Below: a wrapping meta strip of 3 inline check items (green check icon + label): 'cancel from the CLI, anytime', '14-day trial on Pro', 'works in Claude Code & Cursor'.

prompts.partPt: Billing toggle Menu do Topo (#Planos e Preços anchor)
prompts.prompt: A row with a bottom border (border-line, pb-6) introducing the plans. Left: small bold green H2 '> select --plan' (the '>' in ash) + a sub-line in ash '3 tiers. Prices in USD. Toggle for annual (2 months free).' Right: an inline pill toggle group: 'monthly' label (active = green bold glow), a custom switch button (58x30 rounded-full, dim-green border, panel bg, with a 22px round phosphor-green knob that slides ~28px on toggle), 'annual' label, and a small amber outlined badge '-17%' (amber text, amber/15 bg, amber/50 border). Toggle is a real role=switch button; JS swaps prices and suffixes and the active-label styling.

prompts.part: Pricing cards (the core: 3 tiers, Pro highlighted)
prompts.partPt: Planos e Preços cards (the core: 3 tiers, Pro highlighted)
prompts.prompt: A responsive grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of three pricing cards. Each card is a flex-col rounded-lg panel (bg-panel) with a dim-green border, inset green cardline, overflow-hidden, divided into stacked bordered sections: (1) HEADER section: tier name in uppercase wide-tracked ash green + a small lucide icon top-right (circle/zap/users); a large extrabold green price (Free '$0 /forever' at 40px; Pro '$20 /month' at 44px; Team '$60 /seat/mo' at 40px) where the digits carry data-monthly/data-annual for the toggle; a one-line ash description. (2) INSTALL block on panel2 bg: a '# install' comment + a monospace code line '$ npx promptd init --free/--pro/--team' (the '$' in ash). (3) FEATURE list (flex-1): rows using the ASCII [✓]/[ ] bullets, included rows green, excluded rows dimmed; paid tiers lead with a bold green 'Everything in <lower tier>, plus:' row. (4) CTA at bottom: Free and Team use ghost buttons (green text, dim-green border, hover green border+bg), './start --free' and './contact-sales'; Pro uses a solid green button (black text, glow) './start --pro'. The PRO card is visually elevated: border-phos, the green hl-glow halo, z-10, and on lg it is offset upward (lg:-mt-3 lg:mb-3) with a 'recommended' green ribbon tab pinned to its top-right corner (rounded-bl-md). The Team card has md-only centering so the 2-col breakpoint looks balanced (md:col-span-2 md:max-w-[440px] md:mx-auto, reset at lg).

A rounded-lg panel styled as a terminal window. Title bar (panel2 bg, bottom border): three traffic-light dots (red #ff5f56, amber, green at /70 opacity) + a label '$ promptd --compare' in ash. Body on >=sm: a full comparison table (text-[13px], min-w-[560px], horizontal-scroll safety net) with a header row 'capability / free / pro / team' (the 'pro' column header glows green) and ~5 capability rows (prompt copies, generation credits, coding-agent skill, private+versioned prompts, SSO/SAML+roles); cell values are numbers/∞/— or the ASCII [✓]/[ ] marks centered; alternating rows get a barely-there green tint (bg-phos/[0.015]); rows separated by border-line. On mobile (<sm): the table is replaced by three stacked per-tier compare cards (Free/Pro/Team) so no paid column is dropped, each listing the same capabilities as a label/value dl; the Pro card is marked with a left green accent border, a faint green tint, and a small 'recommended' badge.

Two-column on lg (grid lg:grid-cols-[260px_1fr] gap-8). Left rail: small green H2 '> faq --read' + an ash line 'Still got questions? ping us and we'll sort it together.' (warm, friendly voice, 'ping us' is a green link). Right: a list of native <details>/<summary> accordion items separated by border-line, each summary in green semibold with a 'chevron-right' icon that rotates 90deg when open (open[details] .chev rotate). First item open by default. Answers in ash green, indented (pl-7), max-w-2xl, with inline monospace code snippets (e.g. promptd billing --manage). Copy stays casual and reassuring.

Top-bordered footer with a faint green grid background (grid-bg: 32px green grid lines). Centered max-w-[1180px], py-12. Upper area: a 4-column link grid (2-col on mobile) — first cell repeats the logo + tagline 'The terminal-native prompt library for shipping UI fast.'; then 'product', 'resources', 'company' columns of ash-green links (uppercase wide-tracked dim-green headings, hover -> green). Lower bar (top border): left = a shell-echo line '$ echo "© 2026 promptd labs. all rights reserved."' with a blinking cursor ▋; right = github / twitter / discord icon links (dim green, hover green).

special_ui_components.description: A fixed full-viewport overlay of faint horizontal lines that gives the whole page a glowing-monitor/CRT feel.
special_ui_components.prompt: Add a fixed, pointer-events-none, high z-index (z-60) ::before pseudo-element on body covering inset:0, painted with repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0-2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.16) at 3px, transparent 4px), mix-blend-mode:multiply, opacity 0.5. It must sit above content but never intercept clicks.

special_ui_components.description: Green CRT-phosphor glow applied to headings, prices, the highlighted card, and accents.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define a '.glow' text-shadow (0 0 8px rgba(57,255,122,0.45), 0 0 24px rgba(57,255,122,0.18)) and a softer '.glow-soft' (0 0 6px rgba(57,255,122,0.30)) for green text. For the highlighted Pro card define '.hl-glow' box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(57,255,122,0.55), 0 0 40px rgba(57,255,122,0.16), inset 0 0 60px rgba(57,255,122,0.05). Use sparingly on green elements only.

special_ui_components.description: Feature/comparison rows use literal bracketed ASCII marks instead of icon ticks, reinforcing the terminal look.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create '.tick::before' with content '[\002713]' (a bracketed checkmark) in phosphor green and '.nope::before' with content '[ ]' in faint green. Use .tick for included features (green) and .nope for excluded ones (dimmed). Apply the same marks in the comparison matrix cells, centered.

special_ui_components.description: A custom switch that slides a glowing knob and live-swaps every price + suffix and the active label styling.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a role=switch button (58x30 rounded-full, dim-green border, panel bg, inset cardline) with an absolutely-positioned 22px phosphor-green knob (glow-soft) that transitions transform on toggle (translate ~28px). On click: flip aria-checked, slide the knob, swap each price element's text from data-monthly to data-annual, append a ' ·yr' marker to '/month' or '/seat/mo' suffixes, and re-style the 'monthly'/'annual' labels (active = phos + bold + glow-soft, inactive = phosdim + semibold). Pair with a small amber '-17%' savings badge.

special_ui_components.description: A blinking block cursor / square used in the hero, footer echo line, and announcement dot to sell the live-terminal feel.
special_ui_components.prompt: Add a '.cursor-blink' class with a 'blink' keyframe (step-end, 1.1s infinite: opaque 0-49%, transparent 50-100%). Apply to a green block glyph ▋ after the hero paragraph and footer copyright echo, and to a small black square dot in the announcement bar.

special_ui_components.description: The comparison matrix is framed as a macOS-style terminal window with a traffic-light title bar.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap the comparison content in a rounded-lg panel with a panel2 title bar containing three small round dots (red #ff5f56/70, amber/70, phos/70) and a monospace command label '$ promptd --compare' in ash. The window body holds the responsive matrix (table on >=sm, stacked tier cards on mobile).

structured.special_notes: Frameless responsive web page (not a fixed-frame mockup): single centered max-w-[1180px] column, sticky blurred nav, and content that reflows by breakpoint — pricing cards 3->2->1 col (lg/md/sm), and the comparison matrix swaps from a full table (>=sm, with horizontal-scroll fallback at min-w-[560px]) to per-tier stacked cards on mobile so no paid column is ever hidden. Single-accent design system: phosphor green #39ff7a carries the entire UI via glow text-shadows; everything is monospaced (JetBrains Mono + IBM Plex Mono). Heavy terminal motif throughout — shell prompts ($), install lines (npx promptd init --tier), command-style CTAs (./start, ./contact-sales), man-page section headers (> select --plan, > faq --read), ASCII [✓]/[ ] bullets, blinking cursors, a CRT scanline overlay, and a fake-terminal comparison window. Built with Tailwind (CDN config maps the custom palette) + iconify-icon (lucide set); plain-JS billing toggle with data-monthly/data-annual attributes. Voice is warm and dev-native ('ping us and we'll sort it together'), no em-dashes.
